name: When is the best time to start comparing pre-construction opportunities?

mainEntity.name: When is the best time to start comparing pre-construction opportunities?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best time to start comparing pre-construction opportunities is typically during the initial launch phases when pricing is often most competitive and the selection of units is broadest. However, buying early means a longer wait for completion and potential changes to the project. A practical tradeoff is balancing early bird advantages with the certainty of a more developed project. Engaging with us early allows you to receive timely updates on new projects in areas like Aventura or Sunny Isles Beach as soon as they become available.
acceptedAnswer.description: Start comparing pre-construction during initial launch phases for competitive pricing and wider selection. This balances early advantages against longer completion times and potential project changes.
